primary_hypothesis: For nondegenerate DCS-pruned circuits, either independent I/S Clifford companions yield 1-F_T <= 4 E_b[1-F_b] for every stationary correlated stochastic Pauli fault distribution, or there is a quantum-specific explicit family with an exponential lower bound on every such companion certificate and a comparable upper bound.
negative_claims: The O(n^-c) harmless-fault statement in arXiv:2607.25941v2 is false under only its stated circuit-independent arbitrary-correlated Pauli assumptions.
Reference fidelity plus complete syndrome and acceptance data do not identify T-doped fidelity under arbitrary correlated stationary Pauli noise.
